remarks: Location, location, location! Convenient in-town home on lower Milbank Ave only 1 block to train & Greenwich Ave shops, movies & restaurants. Beautifully renovated old-world charm. Large 1st flr office/family rm w/built-ins & bath. Gourmet kitchen w/SS appliances, living rm w/coffered ceiling & fp, marble baths, custom closets, new Hardwood flrs & high ceilings. Formal dining rm opens to an inviting large screened porch, perfect for entertaining. Full length front porch & a back porch overlooking level rear yard, a total of 800 sf outdoor entertaining space. Addt'l living space/office w/bath on LL. Hypo allergenic HVAC system. A special, one-of-a-kind home. 1st & 2nd floors & LL of house. 1 car garage w/charging station & 12ft ceiling to accommodate a car lift if desired. Additional parking for 2 cars.
